url.view: ?view=members switches to the Members ordering, omitted for Committees
url.committee: ?committee=<thomasId> loads Card 4 and scrolls it into view; survives refresh (existing deep link)
url.member: ?member=<bioguideId> loads Card 10 and scrolls it into view; survives refresh (existing deep link)
url.history: filter changes use router.replace; committee and member selections push one entry so Back returns

controls.view: segmented Committees | Members; Members moves Card 10 under the controls, everything else follows
controls.party: segmented mono ALL | D | R | I
controls.sector: chip row: All + the mapped sectors from committee-sectors.js; selected chip emerald; scrolls horizontally
controls.search: one box over committees and members; results grouped (Committees, Members) with codes and party tags; Enter on a result selects it
controls.phone: chamber chips scroll + a Filters chip (count of non-default) opening a bottom sheet with view, party, sector, search, Reset

trades: plus its own side and committee filters

selection.committee_click: atlas tile, gavel row code, matrix row label, trade row code, profile subcommittee parent: all set ?committee= and load Card 4
selection.member_click: gavel person, roster row, seat-load row, trade row member, search result: all set ?member= and load Card 10
selection.continuity: Card 10's Open in Politician Tracker goes to /datasets/politician-tracker?member=<slug>

glance.split: one proportional majority/minority bar with mono counts and text labels

atlas.tiles: grouped House, Senate, Joint; span 2 columns at 55+ seats; split bar, code, seats and sub counts, up to 2 sector chips + '+N'
atlas.selected: emerald border and tint, code chip emerald
atlas.more: '+N more' tile per chamber expands the group in place

gavels.row: avatar, name, party tag, state, committee line, code chip

profile.default: HSIF on first load, else the ?committee= target
profile.subcommittees: chips swap the roster below; Full committee first
profile.roster: facing majority/minority columns ordered by rank; Chair and Ranking badged; 'All N members' expands in place
profile.trades_strip: links to Card 7 with the committee filter applied

oversight.hover: hovering a sector highlights its committees and links; hovering a committee highlights its sectors; emerald for the hot side, links otherwise at 18% chart blue
oversight.click: sector sets the page sector filter; committee loads Card 4
oversight.a11y: focus mirrors hover; a visually hidden table lists committee to sector pairs

seatload.list: top 5 most-seated; person click opens Card 10

trades.summary: window trades, buy vs sell split bar, members traded, unmapped count as a quiet line
trades.filters: side segmented All | Buys | Sells; committee chip opening a committee picker
trades.row: date, member (avatar, party, state), side pill, ticker chip, range as disclosed, sector, committee code

matrix.cell_hover: members holding, buyers and sellers since 180 days, holder names (+N) in the tooltip
matrix.phone: ranked list per committee: top tickers with holder counts

hearings.default: not-yet-available message over a ghost 14-day timeline, link to the committee profile
hearings.future: day rows with committee code, title, optional bill chip, time; gated on the ingest fix

lookup.search: the shared grouped search scoped to members when the card has focus
lookup.seats: chips with code, name, rank and leadership badge
lookup.timeline: 24 months, dot per trade, colour by side, size by disclosure range, unmapped count beside the total

states.loading: shimmer in each card's shape; reserved heights
states.empty: names the active filters plus a way out; Profile and Lookup use select prompts instead
states.error: standard line + Retry refetching only that card
states.hearings_default: the not-yet-available state is the shipped default, not an error

keyboard.segments_chips: radiogroup/radio; search results are a listbox with arrow keys
keyboard.tiles_rows: buttons; atlas tiles and matrix rows included
keyboard.map_matrix: visually hidden table fallbacks; tooltips shown on focus
keyboard.escape: closes the phone filter sheet and clears an open search listbox
